title: A suggestion is a turn the agent asks itself, about Work Quality

screens.title: 1 · A new person: the welcome
screens.why: Nobody has had a suggestion yet: fixed words that never expire, and the first level's question.

pins.label: Fixed copy
pins.text: In app_pt.arb, no model call, never expires (server sends kind: welcome).
Puts the welcome away for 24 h; then the first generated turn, about the goal anyway.

pins.label: Amounts on the page
pins.text: R$ 3.000 · 5.000 · 8.000 open the chat with 'Quero faturar R$ 5.000 este mês.' sent; Outro valor opens it empty.

pins.label: No Work Quality drawn
pins.text: Only the first level's question; no levels, no score, no actions card (no plan).

screens.title: 2 · R$ 5.000 tapped: an ordinary turn
screens.why: The amount is her first message; the answer comes in the same three parts as on Feed.

pins.label: Her message
pins.text: The tapped amount, sent at once. From this answer on, next_at runs.

pins.label: Header = the words
pins.text: In the chat the agent's message is the header; nothing else it says.

pins.label: Preview
pins.text: New preview block: GoalCard as Objetivos draws it, numbers from the dry run, never typed by the model.

pins.label: Actions card
pins.text: Replaces the plan card when there is a preview: the 'Aplicar …' line, Ajustar, Aplicar. Aplicar lets the next level's turn arrive here at once.

screens.title: 3 · Three hours later, on Feed
screens.why: At next_at the server asks itself the first unmet level (reach) and stores the turn as the suggestion.

pins.label: The turn's caption
pins.text: Written by the model; Feed shows only the label and the ✕ beside it (no Objetivo/Entrega tag).

pins.label: Forecast
pins.text: GoalCard with the plan's deliveries in 'queued': reaching R$ 4.200 of 5.000 is visible before Aplicar.

pins.label: ArtifactRow
pins.text: Each delivery as Entregas draws it, on the page's own background, out of the wash.

pins.label: What Aplicar makes
pins.text: The server's line for what the preview can't draw (a task's hour, a removal).

pins.label: Ajustar · Aplicar
pins.text: Ajustar opens the chat on this turn (replaces Conversar); Aplicar applies its plan, Desfazer as today.

pins.label: ✕ until next_at
pins.text: Put away until the next one is due; every answer (✕, Aplicar, a message) sets next_at = now + follow-up, 3–24 h.

screens.title: 4 · Level 6: the routine
screens.why: Once the month's work fits, the turn proposes a routine and a working day: new actions in the registry.

pins.label: Topic by code
pins.text: Work Quality picks the level; the model writes the words, the plan and the follow-up.

pins.label: Routine preview
pins.text: Rotina's fill and hour, the days and the checklist: new_routine with its checklist.

pins.label: Weekdays
pins.text: edit_routine changes hour, rule, checklist of one already there.

pins.label: set_work_day
pins.text: The working day changes by the same Aplicar; said in the actions line.

pins.label: Phone at next_at
pins.text: A local notification 'A Lunna te mandou uma mensagem' at next_at + 1 min, from the reminder plan; no push server.
